test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which city of India was host of ITU’s prestigious World Telecom Standardization Assembly (WTSA 2024)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **World Telecom Standardization Assembly (WTSA)** is a prestigious event organized by the **International Telecommunication Union (ITU)**.
 
• The WTSA event is held every four years and defines the next period of study for the **ITU-T (International Telecommunication Union - Telecommunication Standardization Sector)**.
 
• **New Delhi** being the capital city of India, often hosts such significant international events due to its **strategic importance** and **robust infrastructure**.
 
• The assembly brings together experts from around the world to discuss and set **telecommunication standards** that will shape the future of global communications.
 
• The event in New Delhi underscores India's growing influence and active participation in the global **telecommunications sector**.
 
• Hosting WTSA 2024 in New Delhi aligns with India's goal to become a leader in **information and communication technology (ICT)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Jaipur**__

 __
 
• Jaipur is known as the **Pink City** and is a major tourist destination in India.
 
• It is famous for its rich cultural heritage, including **historical palaces** and **forts**.
 
• While Jaipur hosts various national and regional conferences, it is less likely to host major international telecommunication events compared to New Delhi.
 
 
 
• **Chandigarh**__
 __
 
• Chandigarh is a **union territory** and serves as the capital of both Punjab and Haryana.
 
• It is known for its **modern architecture** and urban planning, designed by the Swiss-French architect **Le Corbusier**.
 
• Though a significant city, it is not a common choice for hosting large-scale international events like the WTSA.
 
 
 
• **Kolkata**__
 
 
• Kolkata, formerly known as Calcutta, is the capital of the Indian state of **West Bengal**.
 
• It is known for its rich cultural and literary heritage, including being the home of the **famous poet Rabindranath Tagore**.
 
• While Kolkata is a major city with significant historical importance, New Delhi's strategic position as the capital gives it an edge in hosting international events like WTSA.
